en-US.title: Prism Duel
en-US.subtitle: Pixel-Art Hologram Card Duels
en-US.promoText: One purchase, the whole game: 80 cards, every monster with its own pixel-art summon and attack. No ads, no in-app purchases — just duels.
en-US.description:
Prism Duel is a fast, tactical card duel in a glowing isometric arena.

Build a deck from 80 original cards — dragons, golems, knights, spells and traps — then summon them as living holograms and battle for the last Life Point.

FEATURES
• Every monster has its own summon, attack and defeat animation, and its own sound
• Duel the CPU, or pass the phone and play a friend on the same screen
• Deck builder with presets, auto-fill and a level curve — drag cards in, drag them out
• Spells, traps, tributes, direct attacks and comebacks in short, readable turns
• Hand-drawn pixel art with soft real-time lighting that fills the whole screen on modern iPhones

ONE PURCHASE, THE WHOLE GAME
• All 80 cards and every mode are included — nothing to unlock, nothing to buy later
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts
• Plays fully offline
• No data collected — your decks stay on your iPhone

review.notes:
1. SCREEN RECORDING
A screen recording captured on a physical iPhone running the latest iOS is attached / linked below. It starts with launching the app from the Home Screen and shows the typical flow: title screen > VERSUS CPU > picking a deck > playing a duel (summoning a monster, setting a card, attacking, the opponent's turn) > the Deck Builder. The app has no account registration, login, user-generated content or in-app purchases, so none of those flows exist.

2. PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
Prism Duel is a single-purchase, offline, turn-based fantasy card game for players aged 13+ who enjoy collectible-card-style strategy. Two players (or one player against the built-in computer opponent) build a deck from 80 original cards and take turns summoning monsters and casting spells and traps to reduce the opponent's Life Points from 4000 to 0. Value: a complete, ad-free strategy card game with hand-drawn pixel art and animations that can be played anywhere, including with a friend on the same phone.

3. HOW TO ACCESS THE MAIN FEATURES
No login, account, setup or sample files are needed.
- Duel the CPU: tap the title screen > VERSUS CPU > choose a deck (e.g. "Classic Deck") > START DUEL. Tap a card in your hand to Summon or Set it, tap BATTLE and then one of your monsters to attack, tap END TURN to pass.
- Two players on one device: tap 2 PLAYERS instead; players take turns on the same phone.
- Deck Builder: title screen > DECK BUILDER. Tap a card to see it, use + / - or drag cards in and out, then SAVE DECK.
- Settings (speed, sound, music): the gear on the title screen.

4. EXTERNAL SERVICES
None. The app makes no network connections and uses no third-party services (no analytics, advertising, authentication, payment, data or AI services). All game logic, art and sound are generated on the device.

5. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
None. The app works identically in every region and contains no region-specific features or content.

6. REGULATED INDUSTRY / THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL
Not applicable. The app is not in a regulated industry and contains no protected third-party material: all card names, characters, artwork, music and sound effects are original and were created for this app.
